text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan achieved great results at the 
Aoba Sho. Yet, deep inside her chest 
lingered an indescribable sense of 
unease...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day. Mejiro Ardan realizes that 
Sakura Chiyono O and Yaeno Muteki will be 
formidable threats in the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, she realizes that the true source 
of her lingering anxiety was the sudden 
rise of those two.
